answer.diagnosis: softmax drops the reduced axis from both its maximum and denominator when keep_dims=False. Subsequent broadcasting aligns remaining dimensions from the right rather than restoring the requested axis. For shape [2,2], dim=1, this applies row statistics across columns: the actual device output is [0.49999997, 0.02993836, 16.55772781, 0.00857748], with all four elements incorrect and maximum absolute error 15.605154. The dim=0 control passes all four elements because right-aligned broadcasting happens to restore that leading axis correctly. Keep the reduced axis as a singleton in both internal reductions so subtraction and division broadcast along the requested axis and preserve the input shape. Retain the public signature and division rounding option. Compilation and post-repair device results are unavailable; the repair is supported by the source and before-repair observations.
